entities.name: Ora Ondar
entities.description: A vertical, centuries-old forest on the continent of Akoum on Zendikar, tended by elves.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane on which Ora Ondar lies.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: Continent of Zendikar containing Ora Ondar.

entities.name: Khalni Stone
entities.description: An ancient artifact and mana refractor at the heart of Ora Ondar, an extension of the true source of the Garden's vitality.

entities.name: Khalni Heart
entities.description: An enormous lotus-like flower of magical life energy that is the true source of Ora Ondar's vitality.

entities.name: Ser Amaran
entities.description: Mutated druid who leads a cult worshipping the kolya trees and acts as their prophetic voice.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker captured at Ora Ondar and later found a Khalni Heart in Bala Ged.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker who killed a keybearer to escape Ora Ondar.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: Captured with Nissa and Sorin by elves of Ora Ondar.

entities.name: Smara
entities.description: A prophet who escaped with the prisoners.

entities.name: Mudheel
entities.description: Goblin guide who escaped with the group.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: Schemer from whose machinations Nissa saved a Khalni Heart.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: Land laid waste by the Eldrazi where a Khalni Heart was found.

entities.name: Battle for Zendikar
entities.description: The conflict against the Eldrazi in 4559 AR.

events.summary: Nissa Revane, Sorin Markov and Anowon are captured by elves of Ora Ondar and imprisoned in the Khalni Garden.
events.quote: Nissa Revane , Sorin Markov , and Anowon were captured by elves of Ora Ondar

events.summary: When Eldrazi brood attack the grove, Sorin kills a keybearer and the prisoners escape with Smara and Mudheel.
events.quote: when Eldrazi brood attacked the grove, Sorin killed a keybearer

events.summary: Nissa Revane finds a Khalni Heart in a cave in Bala Ged and saves it from Ob Nixilis.
events.quote: Nissa Revane found a Khalni Heart in a cave in Bala Ged

relations.quote: is a forest on the continent of Akoum on Zendikar

relations.note: leads a druid cult worshipping the kolya trees
relations.quote: A druid ‑led cult led by Ser Amaran worships these trees
